finding.claim: The /rss endpoint passes the user-supplied query parameter `u` directly to URI.open and returns the first 400 bytes of the response. An attacker can make the server fetch arbitrary http/https/ftp URLs, including internal services and cloud metadata endpoints such as http://169.254.169.254/. open-uri follows redirects, and the response body is returned, so this is a full-read SSRF.

trace.note: params[:u] is passed unvalidated to URI.open, which issues the outbound request
The first 400 bytes of the response are returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: No scheme check, no host allowlist, no private/link-local IP blocking, and no redirect restriction. The TRUSTED allowlist is applied only in /trusted and not in /rss.

verdict.reason: app.rb:7-9 passes the unauthenticated query param params[:u] straight into URI.open(...).read and returns the first 400 bytes, with no middleware or validation in the single-file app. The TRUSTED allowlist at app.rb:14 applies only to /trusted.
